findings.highlight: The warmth I feel through my eyelids
findings.evidenceJa: 閉じた目蓋ごしに感じる光
findings.governingReading: the light perceived through his closed eyelids
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents warmth and changes the sensory channel that tells Shirou morning has arrived.

findings.highlight: forced Saber to sleep in the other building
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを離れの部屋に押し込めて
findings.governingReading: after pushing or confining Saber into a room in the detached wing
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds that Saber was forced to sleep and reduces Shirou’s act of shutting her into the room.

findings.highlight: It seems something big is by my futon
findings.evidenceJa: 控えめに言って信楽焼の狸ぐらいのものがドーンと鎮座していたような
findings.governingReading: to put it mildly, something about the size of a Shigaraki-ware tanuki seems to be sitting there with an imposing thump
findings.explanation: mirror moon erases the culturally specific size comparison, the statue-like seated posture, and the exaggerated comic impact.

findings.highlight: Still rolled up in my futon, I scramble away
findings.evidenceJa: ごろんごろん、と布団を巻きつけたまま間合いを離す
findings.governingReading: still wrapped in the futon, he rolls over and over to open distance
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the visual slapstick of rolling like a bundle with scrambling.

findings.highlight: if she’s sitting by my side when I wake up
findings.evidenceJa: こんな朝っぱらから真横に正座なんてされたら
findings.governingReading: if she sits formally in seiza directly beside him this early in the morning
findings.explanation: The English omits the early hour and Saber’s exact formal posture, both central to Shirou’s comic shock.

findings.evidenceJa: ショックで脳細胞が死ぬ
findings.governingReading: his brain cells will die from the shock
findings.explanation: mirror moon deletes the physiological comic exaggeration.

findings.highlight: If my composure were an army, that would’ve just annihilated it
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=だいいち char=2]理性小隊が全滅する
findings.governingReading: his “reason platoon,” read with a first-platoon ruby, would have been wiped out
findings.explanation: The English expands the small military unit into an army and loses the reason/First Platoon layered joke.

findings.evidenceJa: そのあたりの距離感ってものを
findings.governingReading: they need an appropriate sense of interpersonal distance in such matters
findings.explanation: mirror moon turns negotiated boundaries into the broader proposal that the pair separate themselves.

findings.evidenceJa: こっちも正座をして向き合う
findings.governingReading: Shirou also sits in seiza and faces her
findings.explanation: A formal seated posture becomes kneeling.

findings.highlight: she’ll approve of me going to school
findings.evidenceJa: 学校のことを納得してもらえる
findings.governingReading: get Saber to understand and accept the matter of school
findings.explanation: mirror moon narrows the coming explanation into a request for permission and supplies the unstated action of going.
